_why: mp:MP-LANG lobby follow-up. Every capture is the lobby with both rows seated, so each carries mp:L1b's lobby ping cell ('D <srtt ms>', mh/ui/lobby_ping.cpp) -- a live SRTT MEASUREMENT ('D 0' solo, 'D 1' or 'D 224' under load; the same cell made chat_utf8 flake 2/9). Masked: the cell's whole column on the two seated rows ([322,106,44,36], mp_client_el2's rect) -- the text is laid out by width, so 'D 224' starts 12 px left of 'D 0' and the 'D' moves with the digits (a digits-only mask went red the first time a baseline held a 3-digit value). The 192.168.0.199 header is the rig's pinned HOST_IP, compared as-is like chat_utf8's lobby frames. mp:U50 (2026-10-02): the ping became its own widget right of the flag; the ping-cell rects moved left to x=313 with their right edge unchanged.
